# LTZZZ Video Script — 2026-10-14/15 Pipeline Evidence Check

## Theme
**Evidence-first pipeline** — grounded in the 2026-10-14 render receipt and the 2026-10-15 publishing receipts.  
Different from the 2026-10-12 treasury video and the AI Hiring AI recap.

---

## (a) Full Voice-Over Text

LTZZZ doesn’t celebrate a published video until the receipts agree.  
The brand vertical rendered at 720 by 1280, with audio.  
The YouTube upload came back private—not public.  
The TikTok probe returned “not connected.”  
The daily DeepSeek run timed out, so there’s no model output to trust.  
The pipeline is the proof: every step logged, every gap visible.  
No public launch claimed. Only evidence.

**Word count:** 64

---

## (b) Shot-by-Shot Visual Plan — 9:16 Vertical

### Shot 1 — 0–4s
**Visual:** Dark vertical dashboard. A file card appears: `ltzzz-brand-60s.mp4` with tags `720 × 1280`, `audio: true`, `rendered`.  
**Overlay text:** `RENDERED — NOT PUBLISHED`

### Shot 2 — 4–9s
**Visual:** YouTube publishing receipt UI. Thumbnail placeholder, checkmark for upload, and a prominent privacy badge: `PRIVATE`.  
**Overlay text:** `PRIVATE UPLOAD — NOT PUBLIC`

### Shot 3 — 9–14s
**Visual:** TikTok connector card shown as red/blocked. Error line appears: `TikTok not connected`.  
**Overlay text:** `TIKTOK OAUTH NOT CONNECTED`

### Shot 4 — 14–19s
**Visual:** DeepSeek daily task panel in red. Status tag: `status=exception`. A timeout progress bar stalls.  
**Overlay text:** `TIMEOUT — NO REAL MODEL OUTPUT`

### Shot 5 — 19–23s
**Visual:** Evidence ledger grid. Green checks for rendered/private upload, red crosses for TikTok/DeepSeek gaps.  
**Overlay text:** `PIPELINE = PROOF`

### Shot 6 — 23–25s
**Visual:** LTZZZ logo lockup against dark background.  
**Overlay text:** `NO PUBLIC LAUNCH CLAIMED. ONLY EVIDENCE.`
